# agyn_runner (Resource)

Manages an Agyn runner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_runner" "example" {
  name            = "example-runner"
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  labels = {
    region = "us-east-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Runner name.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Runner labels.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the runner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the runner.
- `identity_id` (String) Identity identifier for the runner.
- `service_token` (String, Sensitive) Service token for the runner.
